scripts.dev: npm run build -w @aeki/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @aeki/api" "npm run dev -w @aeki/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aeki/contracts && npm run build -w @aeki/api && npm run build -w @aeki/web
scripts.test: npm run test:measurements && npm run build -w @aeki/contracts && npm run test -w @aeki/contracts && npm run test -w @aeki/api && npm run test -w @aeki/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aeki/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run measurements:check && npm run contracts:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
